name: Normalize
description: Stretches the R, G and B range of each frame so its darkest and brightest values reach the black and white points.

params.name: blackpt
params.description: Output color the darkest input value of each channel is mapped to

params.name: whitept
params.description: Output color the brightest input value of each channel is mapped to

params.name: independence
params.description: Proportion of per-channel to linked normalization: 0 stretches the three channels together, 1 each on its own

params.name: strength
params.description: Strength, from no change (0) to full normalization (1)
